page.content:
Original Lafayette and Jefferson, the dual-role whirlwind of both acts.

How Daveed Diggs connects

  • Character: Marquis de Lafayette — Daveed Diggs originated Lafayette in the first act.
  • Character: Thomas Jefferson — Daveed Diggs originated Jefferson in the second act.

What is Daveed Diggs?

Daveed Diggs originated Marquis de Lafayette in act one and Thomas Jefferson in act two, a double that won him a Tony and set the show's French-to-Cabinet pivot.

Key threads lead to Marquis de Lafayette and Thomas Jefferson.
